sources.method: Official material role guidance, regular/clear and accessibility behavior.
Official native typography roles and platform-specific default sizes.
Authored NativeProbe.swift; explicit NSAppearance + NSColor runtime sampling and selected-window screencapture. REA binary binding succeeded; native AX observation unavailable.

evidence.finding: The navigation/control layer uses Liquid Glass; content uses stable, readable surfaces.
Nine NSColor semantic roles resolved under four explicit appearance names. sRGB components and alpha retained. Contrast-name samples did not change in this environment.
Authored macOS AppKit window renders regular and clear system glass over synthetic swatches. This is a framework specimen, not a captured Apple product app.
CSS material approximation and Fieldnotes library/preferences apply the documented material roles. Blur, radii, opacity and layout values are authored.

prototype.stack: Static HTML/CSS/JavaScript and an authored AppKit probe
prototype.reason: An inspectable gallery package with local synthetic state needs no framework/backend. This choice does not prescribe a future product stack.
prototype.run: python3 scripts/gallery.py build --output <empty-directory>; serve the output with python3 -m http.server

new_screen.reason: Preferences screen rendered in dark desktop and light mobile, labels/toggle/disabled/save-error-retry exercised.

visual.reason: Light/dark/solid browser captures visually inspected against measured semantic roles and the native AppKit specimen. Optical pixel identity not claimed.

states.reason: Search no-result, empty/loading/error/retry, new note, modal and settings feedback checked with synthetic local data.

responsive.reason: Desktop/mobile viewport screenshots and no-horizontal-overflow checks at 390/768/1440 CSS px. New screen checked at 390 px; physical devices not tested.

accessibility.reason: Scoped check: named controls, keyboard focus and Escape restoration, disabled state, local status messages and selected contrast pairs. This is not a complete WCAG/VoiceOver or native accessibility audit.

publication.notes: Authored implementation and measurements. No Apple image, logo, font file, application binary, user data or source dump.
